description: This file defines the class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject', which extends 'HTMLPurifier_Injector' to add safety features to object elements in HTML by injecting parameters and managing object stacks for safety purposes.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_SafeObject
classes.description: A class responsible for injecting safety parameters into object tags in HTML to prevent security issues.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context, calling the parent prepare method.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Handles 'object' and 'param' elements to inject safety parameters and manage internal stacks.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of 'object' elements to clean up internal stacks.
